title: MerlMC
description: MerlMC is the Towny Minecraft server hosted by the Twitch Streamer Merl!
body:
MerlMC is the Minecraft Towny Server owned by the Twitch Streamer Merl.

It's a community SMP running the Towny plugin where you can create your town, invite friends, and participate in events when they run!

![MerlMC Keyart](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/72308749d55d261f50c67f70ccb4c71e09afe4d8.png)
